title: proto.midi
description: `proto.midi` is a raw MIDI encoder and parser: it accepts raw MIDI bytes and outputs both raw bytes and parsed, selector-based messages, while its methods generate common channel, system, real-time, and SysEx messages. For channel messages, channel numbers use the range 0–15; methods such as `notes_off` and `sound_off` can target all channels when the channel argument is omitted or set to -1.
